crypto-daily-report 1.0.0 changelog:

- Initial release of the skill for generating daily crypto news reports.
- Collects, processes, and formats data from leading news, price, DeFi, Meme, and funding sources.
- Follows a strict multi-section structure; each daily report is sent in three messages to Telegram.
- Implements failover and fallback strategies for all key data sources.
- Fully silent execution—no user-facing progress or status messages.
- Ensures all outputs come strictly from verified, real-time collected data.
